headline: Apple launches AI health study app to learn how people use AI tools
summary: Apple has launched the Apple Health AI Usage Study, a research app aimed at understanding how people interact with conversational AI health tools and how useful their responses are, built in collaboration with clinical AI platform OpenEvidence.

claims.statement: Apple launched a new research app, the Apple Health AI Usage Study, to learn how people use AI health tools.

claims.statement: The study is conducted in collaboration with OpenEvidence, a clinical AI platform used by healthcare professionals.
